ramp_assessment.scope: Exact reference-kinematics review of the proposed centered 50 ms ramp. No new controller trace or implementation batch.
ramp_assessment.preview_requirement: The centered ramp starts at 0.225 s, 25 ms before a replan arriving at 0.25 s. It needs advance knowledge or an explicitly earlier admission.
ramp_assessment.same_task_assessment: It changes the velocity and position reference. Error measured only relative to the new reference cannot establish repair of the original fixed task.
ramp_assessment.causal_fixed_endpoint_obstruction: At t=0.25 s the original q2=2.5 m/s^2. Reaching q2=0 at t=0.5 s with |j|<=10 requires integral j=-2.5, the lower bound over 0.25 s. Therefore j=-10 almost everywhere on that interval. A nonzero continuous ramp from +10 cannot preserve that acceleration endpoint and deadline within the same jerk limit.
ramp_assessment.restart_requirement: Explicitly allow a timing/endpoint/jerk-limit change or prove a causal endpoint-matched feasible reference on a broader horizon; compare methods on the same accepted task and error definition.

pause_reason: Both fixed laws violate the assigned target. The proposed centered ramp changes the reference task and requires preview; it does not preserve the fixed endpoint/timing contract. Further tube formalization or single-case task relaxation is not justified.
restart_requirements: Permitted timing change and required terminal position, velocity, acceleration.
Stated motion/command limits and external-task versus internal-reference error definition.
Preserve all current failing traces and target values.
